description: A WPF app using Windows App SDK TextRecognizer on an Arm Copilot+ PC gets a catastrophic failure, based on https://github.com/microsoft/WindowsAppSDK/issues/5684.
prompt: We have to keep this as a WPF line-of-business app, but I want to add modern on-device OCR. TextRecognizer.GetReadyState says NotReady, EnsureReadyAsync returns Failure with an empty message, and CreateAsync throws 'catastrophic failure' on a Snapdragon X Plus Windows 11 machine. Should I rewrite the UI in WinUI just for this feature?
